svg.text: SECTION OVERVIEW · METHOD + MECHANISM + EQUATIONS
BLOCK QUANTIZATION: VALUES, SCALES, AND
ERROR
1. Represent a compact value
Both use a 4-bit E2M1 payload
Only a small set of magnitudes is available
A scale maps the grid to the original range.
2. Compare scale granularity
NVFP4: 16 values per E4M3 block scale
MXFP4: 32 values per E8M0 block scale
NVFP4 also uses a tensor-level FP32 scale.
3. Reconstruct and compare
NVFP4: x ≈ s tensor × s block × q
MXFP4: x ≈ s block × q
Outliers stretch the scale and coarsen resolution.
4. Validate the complete method
Check error, kernels, and scale overhead
Effective bits exceed 4 after metadata
Format support alone does not guarantee speed.
Read 1 → 4, then use the section derivation to check the assumptions.
